description: The board's vocabulary and volume: every occupation category with its live count, the states that currently have listings, the total active count and the first-party vs imported split. employer_feed counts the imported rows that came from an employer's own careers feed, so an agent does not mistake them for scraped third-party inventory. Call this first to learn valid filter values and how much inventory exists before searching.
name: list_categories
title: List categories, states and live counts
